name: Nuki Smart Lock Pro 4th Gen (EU)

radios.note: Nuki's generations table lists built-in Wi-Fi and Matter over Thread for the Pro; Bluetooth is how the app and keypad talk to the lock.

matter.note: CSA lists 'Nuki Smart Lock Pro (4th Generation)' (listing seen: firmware 1.4.0, hardware 7.07, certified 2025-04-23). Wi-Fi is used for the Nuki app and remote access, not for Matter.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread; needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Nuki Web cloud integration; needs a Nuki Web account. Nuki says voice unlock is currently off in Google Home. Matter over Thread also works with a Thread border router.

alexa.note: Nuki Web cloud integration (Nuki Smart Home skill), which needs a Nuki Web account. Matter over Thread is also supported; Nuki's hub table lists which Echo devices work.

smartthings.note: Nuki lists Samsung SmartThings as a Matter hub. A Thread border router is needed.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Nuki page says 4th generation Smart Locks support Matter over Thread and integrate through the Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router. MQTT is also documented.

hubRequired.note: Nuki says the Pro has built-in Wi-Fi and needs no Bridge or hub; remote access via Thread is included. Matter control needs a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No Nuki source describes offline or local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Mounts on the inside of the door over a Europrofile (and some Swiss Round) cylinder. Your key still works from outside only if the cylinder has an emergency function.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock. Nuki sells the Keypad 2 NFC as a separate accessory, and it works with this lock.

power.note: Built-in lithium-ion battery, charged over a magnetic USB-C port in about two hours, including on the door.

summary: Nuki's Smart Lock Pro (4th generation) mounts on the inside of a Europrofile cylinder and has Wi-Fi built in, so remote access needs no bridge. It speaks Matter over Thread for Apple Home, SmartThings and Home Assistant, and Google Home and Alexa also work through Nuki's cloud. The battery is built in and recharges over USB-C. The keypad is a separate accessory.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router, such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K; Nuki's hub table shows which Echo devices work.
Nuki says voice unlock is currently off in Google Home; app controls work.
Your key only works from outside if the cylinder has an emergency function.
The Keypad 2 NFC is a separate accessory.
Nuki now lists a 5th-generation Pro and shows this model as legacy.
